title: The Journey of Victor
subtitle: From ideation in 2009 to a pan-India corporate fleet and international expansion across the United Arab Emirates.

milestones.description: Victor was registered as a private limited company under Indian Companies Act 1956.
We landed Top Client from top Companies after 2 Years of being in service in the industry.
We increased our fleet to more than 800+ vehicles.
We increased our fleet to more than 1,500+ vehicles.
During COVID-19 outbreak we decided to re-educate our drivers and partners on the new norms provided by WHO.
We successfully navigated the challenges faced during the Pandemic & Resumed our business operations at full capacity.
We decided to expand PAN-INDIA by providing operations in metropolitan cities in India.
We expanded our reach and established ourselves in the International Markets starting with United Arab Emirates (U.A.E)
We took a vow towards sustainability making sure our fleet will have 15%-30% electric vehicles.
We started full fledged operations across PAN-INDIA.
We started full fledged operations in United Arab Emirates (U.A.E)
